translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Vitoubobuta paila Amoni kala kamwaga
E Guyau ilukwaigu kawala,
“Mwa yoku tau, kukwagai biga baisa viloumwaidona Amoni.

E kuluki matausina binakaigalaisi avaka yeigu Guyau Yaubada lalilivala. Yokomi komwaidomi deli mi mwasawa avai tuta lokugisaisi ulo Bwala Kwebumaboma bogwa lokuyogwalaisi, deli mi mwasawa avai tuta lokugisaisi viluwela Isireli bogwa eivilouwokuva, deli mi mwasawa avai tuta lokugisaisi tomotala Yuda eiloulabasi okatupipi.

Paila uula eivigaki kala mwamwasila ninami, yeigu batugwali dalesi mavilousina metoya mapilana opilibomatu, bimaisi biyoulimi. Matausina bibudaisi si kabeikau omi valu bimilivalusi baisa. E bikamsi kami kawailuwa e bimomwaisi kami sopi baisa mwada paila titoulemi.
Yeigu bavigaki viluwela Raba bivagi si valu kameli, deli viloumwaidona viluwela Amoni bivigakaisi si valu sipi, mapaila yokomi bukunikolaisi yeigu goli Guyau.
“Baisa avaka Guyau Yaubada ililivala. Yokomi lokukwatupatusi yumami deli kuyuweitaulasi paila mi mwasawa. Yokomi bogwa kukwaluwouwaisi valu Isireli.

Bogwa lokuvagaisi makawala e mauula yeigu bakasalaimi oyumasi boda ituwoli ituwoli matausina bilebwaimi e bikwaiyaisi mi guguwa. Yeigu bakodidaimi mi boda bitamwauvagasi wala, e gala tuvaila bitanikoli yokomi budotala boda budoveka kaina bitoemwa kwaitala mi valu tatoumi. E oluvi bukunikolaisi yeigu goli Guyau.”
Vitoubobuta paila Mowabi kala kamwaga
E Guyau Yaubada ilivala kawala, “Paila Mowabi eilivala mwada Yuda makawala boda ituwoli ituwoli,
yeigu batugwali valu mavilousina mwada eivabodaisi kaligeila Mowabi bikatudidaimisi, deli goli mavilousina viloumatabwaila - Beti Yesimoti, Beali Meoni, deli Kiriataim.
Yeigu batagwala dala madalasina oviloupakala mapilana opilibomatu biyoulisi Mowabi, deli goli Amoni, e Mowabi gala tuvaila bitadoki kwaitala boda.
Yeigu bamipuki mina Mowabi, e matausina binikolaisi yeigu goli Guyau.”
Vitoubobuta paila Edom kala kamwaga
Guyau Yaubada ilivala kawala, “Tomotala Edom ikeulasi kasi lugwa baisa mina Yuda vakatutuki saina vakaigaga, e lugwa makwaina iyomitali mina Edom si sula kwekanuvagasi.

Baisa tuta bogwa lakabau bamipuki Edom e bakatumati tomotala deli maunela komwaidona. Yeigu bavigaki mavilouna viloupakala, bivitouula valu Temani bila ovalu Dedani, e tomotasi bikatumataisi okabilia.

Ulo tomota mina Isireli bikeulasi agu lugwa baisa mina Edom e bivigakaisi mina Edom bilumkolaisi tigininila ulo gibuluwa. E matausina bikatetasi ammakawala bakau kaimapu.” Guyau Yaubada bogwa eilivala.
Vitoubobuta paila Pilisitia kala kamwaga
Guyau Yaubada ikaibiga kawala, “Mina Pilisitia ikeulasi kasi lugwa saina vakatutuki vakaigaga baisa matausina si tilaula Pilisitia e leikatumataisi matausina metoya okasi leiya.
Baisa uula lakabau baisa yokomi, yeigu bakabilii mina Pilisitia e bakatudoum matausina. Yeigu bamtuli komwaidona matausina kesala eisisuaisi oviluwela Pilisitia.
Yeigu bamipuki matausina mwaugaga deli bayovigasi wala kokeula lugwa baisa matausina. Matausina bilumkolaisi ulo gibuluwa. E binikolaigusi yeigu goli Guyau.”
